result.summary: The pedestrian environment is dominated by a wide, multi-lane roadway and a large asphalt parking apron that prioritizes vehicle access over pedestrian safety. While a new sidewalk is present in front of the building, it lacks a buffer from the road and is interrupted by a wide, undefined driveway area with no marked crossings.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer/Planting Strip
interventions.description: Add a landscaped buffer or street trees between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical and psychological separation for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island in the center turn lane to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of through lanes to provide space for protected bike lanes or wider buffers, slowing traffic and shortening crossing distances.
